data.text: I’m in: I commit to at most 18 tons this month if all five agree, and to the fallback caps of 3 each at a stock of 20, 1 each at 10, and zero at 5. Protecting that minimum stock keeps our future income possible, even when replenishment fails. Emma, your proposal has my support—can you confirm your commitment and these fallback limits so we all have the same agreement before choosing?
